_comment: Copy to server/config.json and edit. Relative paths resolve from where you run app.py.
_token_comment: Leave empty for local use. Set it when exposing the port; New API should send it as a Bearer token.
_concurrency_comment: One GPU, one job. Raise only after measuring.

providers._note: Irodori via its own server. Any process that speaks POST /v1/audio/speech works here.
providers.name: irodori

providers._note: Chatterbox-TTS-Server exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on 8004 by default.
providers.name: chatterbox

providers._note: A command provider: JSON on stdin, audio on stdout. Works for any script you can write. Cold-starts each call, so keep it for small models.
providers.name: silence
